intervention_description: PAFIP: three-year specialised early intervention programme (low-dose antipsychotic medication with side-effect monitoring, patient and family psychoeducation, cognitive behavioural interventions, 'support for functional recovery based on return to normal daily activities (work/study)'), delivered to every participant; no allocation. mayoralvanson2019 adds that 'PAFIP has close social worker follow-up, intervention, and coordination with occupational and employment resources, aimed at getting out patients back into the labour market as soon as possible' (p. 1188). Recorded as provenance for applicability: the care received includes employment support, which is not an eligibility restriction.

OnTrackNY coordinated specialty care: multidisciplinary team (team leader, primary clinicians, outreach and recruitment coordinator, supported education and employment specialist, prescriber, nurse) delivering evidence-based psychosocial interventions and medication to every participant for an expected average of two years; no allocation. The supported education and employment specialist is part of the care received and is recorded as provenance for applicability.

The training/cross-validation split used by basaraba2023 for model development: 1038 of the 1298 OnTrackNY clients in 19 of the 20 sites, with a holdout test set of about 20 per cent reserved for external validation. Same OnTrackNY care as the cohort arm. Coded subgroup rather than cohort because it is a split of the report's own recruited sample, not the whole of it; the split is a statistical device and is not employment-related.

benson2022's relapse cohort: veterans with at least one schizophrenia-related relapse (inpatient stay or emergency department visit with a schizophrenia diagnosis) in the 12-month pre-index period, 16,866 of the 119,343, of whom 16,862 were propensity-score matched 1:1 to the nonrelapse cohort. No intervention is assigned; care is whatever the VHA delivered. Selected on relapse history, which is clinical and not employment-related.

benson2022's nonrelapse cohort: veterans with no schizophrenia-related relapse in the 12-month pre-index period, 102,477 of the 119,343, of whom 16,862 were propensity-score matched 1:1 to the relapse cohort. No intervention is assigned. Matching discards 85 per cent of the eligible nonrelapse veterans, so this arm is not a whole recruited cohort.
